statement: Fix 0 < q < 1, a rational simple orthogonal polygon Ω, and four distinct ideal side-interior marks p, b, c, d0 in counterclockwise order. Choose M clearing all wall coordinates. For n ∈ MN, use the exact whole-tile graph of Ω at mesh 1/n, with either global color designation and the flat marked gaps of the specified color-visit convention within O(1/n) of the ideal marks. Use the open-cap and deterministic separate-wire laws defined above. Only the marked gaps are rounded in this auxiliary experiment; the polygon walls remain exact. Choose a conformal half-plane coordinate taking (p, b, c, d0) to (0, χ, 1, ∞), where 0 < χ < 1. 167 Then, along every sequence n → ∞ in MN, Popen(EA) −→ r(χ) := Z ∞ 1 uρ−1 |u − χ|ρ−1 |u − 1|1−3ρ du Z ∞ χ uρ−1 |u − χ|ρ−1 |u − 1|1−3ρ du . (9.87) Under deterministic separate A wires, the actual crossing probability tends to r(χ) r(χ) + d(1 − r(χ)) . (9.88) Moreover hn converges locally uniformly to the conformal map of Proposition 9.13 with r = r(χ). The open-cap function satisfies r(1 − χ) = 1 − r(χ). If g denotes (9.88), the complementary separate-wire probability is 1 − r dr + 1 − r = 1 − g 1 − (1 − q)g . (9.89)
